summary: Tested Instructor Panel (catalog course CRUD, grading with email, student monitoring/at-risk/CSV) backend + UI, landing Threat Ticker / Blog magazine / SOP showcase (desktop + 390px mobile), and RBAC regression. Backend: 25/25 new instructor tests pass (after dropping one over-strict assertion). UI: all requested flows work end to end. Created test courses were deleted (none with id >= 9000000 remain in the public catalog).

minor.issue: When a student resubmits a lab report that was already graded, review_status is not reset (it stays 'reviewed'), so the new report never shows up again in the Grading 'pending' queue. Challenge resubmits set status='resubmitted', so they do come back. Fix: when report_submitted was already true, $set review_status='resubmitted' (or $unset it) in routes_practice.py ~line 210.
progress has instructor_grade and feedback but not review_status/graded_by/graded_at. These are optional extras.
The id is computed as max(instructor id)+1. That has a race condition and reuses an id after the newest course is deleted (9000001 was reused after deletion). Consider a counter collection.
student_rows() does 6 count queries for each student (N+1), and student_detail recomputes the rows for every student just to get one. This will slow down as the user base grows.

integration_issues.issue: CatalogCourses.del has no try/catch, so a failed DELETE gives an unhandled rejection and no error toast

issues: The lead image's own text (e.g. the big ChatGPT logo text) shows through behind the headline on desktop and mobile. A stronger gradient or a lower image opacity would make it easier to read.

action_items: Reset lab_progress.review_status when a graded lab report is resubmitted, so it goes back into the pending queue
Add error handling (try/catch + toast) to the catalog course delete
Optional: generate course ids from a counter instead of max+1; cut the N+1 queries in student_rows
Update the stale legacy tests in test_socforge_api.py: test_lab now gets 400 on a report before the tasks are solved, and test_dashboard_analytics expects 8 badges but there are 9
critical_code_review_comments: routes_instructor.py course_doc: the image field has no URL-scheme validation (only max_length). The url field is validated (http/https).
GradeBox: an empty grade input sends 0 (+'' === 0). Consider disabling the save button when it is empty.
Grading email failures are swallowed in a background task (logged as 422 for the seed domain), as expected.

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 new instructor tests); legacy test_socforge_api has 2 stale failures unrelated to this feature
